title: Gugelhupf (Babka-style Cake)
description: A cake made with yeast, melted butter, and parmesan cheese.

ingredients.name: 2 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 1/16 liter warm cream
1 egg and 3 egg yolks beaten in 1/16 liter cream

steps: Place 40 deca flour, 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 tablespoon salt in a deep bowl
Dissolve 2 deca fresh yeast in 1/16 liter warm cream
Beat 1 egg and 3 egg yolks in 1/16 liter cream and add to the yeast mixture
Pour this into the flour mixture and stir together into a dough
Add 4 deca melted butter, stir well and beat the dough until it separates from the spoon
Cover with a cloth and let it rest in a warm place
When the dough has risen, place it on a flour-dusted board and roll out to the thickness of a small finger
Cut out round flat pieces using a doughnut cutter and place on a buttered baking sheet
Make 3 indentations in each piece with a spoon handle
Place pea-sized pieces of butter in each indentation and sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese
Bake in a fairly hot oven until golden and serve warm

ingredients.name: 2 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 3 tablespoons milk

Lightly fold in egg white from 6 eggs simultaneously with 28 deca flour
Warm a gugelhupf mold, coat with butter, line with flour and arrange sliced almonds around the sides

title: Gugelhupf im Ordinären (Ordinary Gugelhupf)
description: Prepared with lard or butter, egg yolks, and yeast.

ingredients.name: 14 deca lard or drippings or 10 deca butter
3 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 3/4 liter lukewarm milk
flour or breadcrumbs for lining the mold

steps: Beat 14 deca lard or drippings or 10 deca butter with 1/8 liter milk until fluffy
Add 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, 3 egg yolks and 1 whole egg one after another, stirring
Mix in 3 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 3/4 liter lukewarm milk and 1 liter flour
Beat the dough until it separates from the spoon
Mix in 8 deca raisins and 8 deca currants
Warm a gugelhupf mold with a hole, coat heavily with butter and line with flour or breadcrumbs
Fill the mold with dough, distribute evenly, cover and place in a warm location
When the dough has risen to double its height, place the mold in the oven and bake initially at strong heat, later at moderate heat for 1 hour
Remove the mold from the oven, turn out onto a sieve and sprinkle with powdered sugar after cooling completely
To check if it is baked through, insert a pastry needle; if it comes out dry without dough, it is done

title: Gugelhupf im Ölbittertetter (Gugelhupf with Oil and Bitter Flavor)

ingredients.name: 2 deca fresh yeast dissolved in 1/4 liter cold milk

If the dough is too stiff, add 3 tablespoons milk
Lightly fold in egg white from 2 eggs and 14 deca raisins
Coat a gugelhupf mold with butter, line with flour and fill with dough
Place 2 tablespoons on the mold and cover with a cloth to prevent air from entering
Let the dough rise near the hearth until it has doubled in height
Place in a moderately hot oven and bake for 1 hour

title: Gummer Torteletten (Summer Tartlets)

title: Guter Weinesssig (Good Wine Vinegar)
description: Prepared with wine.

ingredients.name: One measure of very sour wine vinegar

steps: Let one measure of very sour wine vinegar and two measures of country wine stand in a container made of two well-fired clay vessels for several days in sun or oven warmth
Fill it up again with two measures, and continue thus until the container is full
Let it sour for at least eight days
Filter two measures from it and pour into the other container
Fill the first one again, and gradually fill up the second as well
When you need to use from the first, refill it from the second, and fill the second again with wine
In this way you always have good wine vinegar
If you throw in some pieces of sugar from time to time, the vinegar becomes much more spirited

title: Gänsleber-Kuchen mit Aspik (Goose Liver Cake in Aspic)
description: A cake made with goose liver, aspic, and bacon.
steps: Finely chop 32 decagrams of goose liver and 16 decagrams of bacon.

In a mortar, combine with 12 decagrams of bread crumbs softened in milk and well pressed out, 5 juniper berries, 3 pieces of thinly sliced mushrooms roasted in 4 decagrams of butter, 4 egg yolks, and 1 whole egg, some salt and pepper.
Pound together and pass through a sieve into a deep bowl.
Add 12 decagrams of ground truffles, 12 decagrams of smoked, softly cooked tongue, and if available, 12 decagrams of softly cooked calf's sweetbread.
All must be finely diced and well mixed.
Fill into a form brushed with butter and dusted with flour.
Place a thin layer of bacon on top with a cut made in the middle and cook 2 hours covered in a water bath.
Turn out onto a funnel plate and let the form rest over it for another 1.5 hours.
Remove the form, clean it, and place in ice.
Pour a finger-high layer of cooled aspic into it and let it set.
Decorate with finely cut-out truffles, nicely arranged tongue or hard-boiled eggs and some lettuce leaves or parsley sprigs.
Pour another finger-high layer of aspic and let cool well.
Turn out the cake (which has been trimmed in the meantime) onto it in the same position as it was in the form.
Fill the empty space in the middle with aspic, which should also completely cover the cake above.
After this has stood 1 hour in ice, hold briefly in warm water, wipe the form, and quickly turn the cake onto a flat platter.
Garnish with neatly cut aspic or decorate with colored butter.
The cake can also be cut into pieces and these laid in aspic.

title: Hachierte Beefsteaks (Ground Beefsteaks)

Add 12 decagrams of diced, leafy-cut bread crusts that have been soaked in water and well pressed out, then 2 whole eggs and 1 egg yolk, salt and spices.

Spread the mass on a flour-dusted board, form into thick pieces or 4 beefsteaks, making them 1-2 fingers high and of desired size.
Dust them on both sides with flour and fry them in very hot butter or fat for 12-15 minutes.

title: Halte Casserolle Pastete (Cold Cassole Pâté)
description: Prepared with bacon, forcemeat, and meat or pork or veal or game.

ingredients.name: Raw meat (pork, veal, game or poultry)

steps: Prepare ½ kilo butter dough and let it rest.
Butter a small cassole and line it with spices, then line it with thinly rolled and neatly cut-out butter dough in any desired pattern.
Cut a 2 knife-back-thick dough plate to fit the size of the cassole bottom, place it on the decoration brushed with egg, and press lightly.
Cut a strip of butter dough rolled out 2 knife-back-thick, as wide and long as the height and circumference of the cassole require.

Brush the diagonally cut ends of the strip with beaten egg and position the strip at the side wall of the cassole so that the edge of the strip and the bottom plate edge touch, and the both egg-brushed ends of the strip overlap well.

To give the connection of the side wall with the bottom plate more security, brush a strongly knife-back-thick and 2 finger-wide butter dough strip with beaten eggs and lay this brushed side at the joint of the dough so that one half of the strip's width adheres firmly to the bottom and the other half to the side wall.
Line the bottom and side walls with thin bacon slices, brush 2 fingers high with arbitrary forcemeat, and place arbitrary raw meat (pork, veal, game, or poultry) on top.

Brush the remaining empty space and the forcemeat with forcemeat, place 1 bacon slice over it, and cover this with a dough plate fitted to the size of the cassole, whose edge must be pressed together with that of the side wall.
Score the lid several times with a knife, brush with beaten eggs, and bake the pâté for 2 hours in the oven.

steps: Cut the skinned hare into 2 finger-width pieces

title: Hase Pâteten (Hare Pâté Strudel)

Add the young hare liver, ¼ liter red wine, spices, thyme, 5 crushed juniper berries, and 1 bay leaf, and braise covered until soft.
When done, remove all meat from the bones, strain the liquid, and finely pound all remaining ingredients in a mortar, then pass through a sieve. It should be as thick as a purée.
Make butter dough from 32 deca flour of the finest kind and roll it out strong, knife-back thickness, in strips 2 hand-widths wide and ½ meter long.
Spread the meat mixture about 1 finger high and 3 fingers wide in the middle of the strips.

Score the dough several times with a knife and place the filled butter dough on a baking sheet wetted with cold water.
Bake at fairly strong heat.

title: Heavily Candied Quince Slices (Schwergekochte Quitten-Spalten)
description: Prepared with quince or apples or pears, lemon juice, and lemon.
steps: Cut the quince apples or pears into arbitrary pieces and remove the seed cavities

Place the filled jars unclosed in a breezy location and after several days bind them with writing paper, which you pierce with a needle to let air in

title: Homemade French Wine from Raisins (Franzwein aus Rosinen)

steps: Take raisins of the largest and best sort and tear them into small pieces, which is better than cutting them

title: Honig oder Meth (Honey Mead)
description: Prepared with honey, hops, and yeast.
steps: Best made on warm summer days.
Bring 8 Maß of spring water per 1 Maß of honey into a kettle and hang a sachet with hops (0.5 pound per 100 pounds honey) and, if desired, also with mace, cardamom and the like inside.
Simmer slowly over charcoal fire and skim diligently. If you add egg white before cooking, the impurities separate more easily.
Once all is skimmed, remove the fire from under the kettle and allow the mass to cool to the point that no egg can any longer be hard-boiled in it. The cooking should not last too long overall.

Test with a freshly laid egg: if it sinks so deep that only the tip is visible, the mead is correct; if it sinks completely under, there is still too much water, which must be evaporated; if it swims on top, there is too much honey and more water must be added.
When cooled, fill into a barrel with an addition of purest yeast, though some space must remain on top.
Once fermented, it remains for 3 months and is then drawn off and treated like wine.

Note: it is preferable to use the water left over from wax pressing instead of common water; one can also bring the honey cooked and skimmed with 4 to 8 parts water over gentle fire directly to barrels and let it ferment without addition, but add yeasts or some other fermentation agent to weak mead; and a well-prepared mead is said to equal the best and most delightful Spanish wines.
If it is sent far from its homeland and has not sufficiently fermented, it will enter into new fermentation in warmth and not rarely bursts the bottles as violently as Champagne wine.

title: Indianer mit Trüffeln gefüllt (Truffle-Stuffed Turkey)
description: Prepared with turkey, truffles, and lard.
steps: For 1 small turkey, take 1 1/2 kilo truffles.
Clean them and cut them finely; cut 1 kilo of the truffles into strips.
Finely chop the remaining 1/4 kilo truffles and 1/4 kilo lard, place in a saucepan, add finely cut herbs, shallots, some thyme, and necessary salt.
Pluck a young, fat turkey immediately after bleeding, carefully remove the entrails, and fold the breast bone on both sides.
Truss the turkey and clean it inside and outside with a cloth.
Cut the turkey liver finely, add it to the truffles in the saucepan, and roast for 10-15 minutes.
Place the roasted mixture in a deep bowl, mix in the truffle strips cut into pieces, and let cool.
When cooled, fill the still warm turkey with this mixture, especially the crop, to give it a more beautiful appearance.
Sew the opening shut and wrap the turkey in lard plates and paper.
Let it rest for 5-6, or at most 8 days in a cool place, or it can be roasted the same day with the truffles, but the turkey must be at a cooler temperature.
After this time, remove it, take off paper and lard, salt the turkey, truss it, bind it with inserted lard, and roast on the spit or in the oven for approximately 2 hours.
If you want the turkey roasted white, wrap it in paper during roasting; if you want it golden, remove the paper 1/3 of an hour before finishing and roast it at a brighter fire.

steps: For a small veal leg, remove the outer skin, hack off the knee bone at the so-called joint above the knee disc, separate the meat from the bone and push it back.

After the leg has been completely cleaned and skinned, salt the meat well on all sides and let it rest for a while.

While still warm, peel off the skin.
Slice the tongue, salt it, bread it, fry in hot lard.

title: Kalte Erdbeerensupptie (Cold Strawberry Soup)
description: A soup made with strawberries, white wine, and juice.
steps: Lay 2 liters ripe strawberries on a cloth and select with a needle approximately one-third of the most beautiful berries, which are then placed in a vessel and set on ice.
Press the remaining strawberries through a sieve into an earthenware bowl.
Stir the sieved strawberries with approximately 1 kilo crushed sugar until well combined.
Pour 2 liters white wine (preferably Rhine wine) with the juice of 1 lemon into the mixture.
Strain the whole once more through a sieve into a soup pot already buried in ice.
Cover the pot and let it sit cold for approximately 3 to 4 hours.
Add the whole strawberries, stir everything together lightly, and serve in a deep glass or porcelain bowl at table in soup bowls or in glasses suitable for this purpose.

title: Kalte Himbeeren-Suppe (Cold Raspberry Soup)
description: A soup made with raspberries, white wine, and juice.
steps: Place 2 liters raspberries in very fresh water, then immediately lay them on a cloth and select with a needle approximately one-third of the most beautiful berries, which are placed in a large bowl, scattered with sugar, and set on ice.
Let 1 kilo sugar boil well in 1/2 liter water, pour this hot over the remaining raspberries and let it sit covered for approximately 3 hours.
Strain this through a sieve, pour 2 liters white wine and the juice of 1 lemon into it, strain it once more through a sieve into a porcelain bowl.
Mix in the whole raspberries and serve the soup at table.

title: Kalte Lachs-Pâtete (Cold Salmon Pâté)
description: Prepared with salmon, truffle, and bay leaf.

ingredients.name: Several finger-thick slices of salmon fillet
Truffle pieces, pencil-thick and half-finger long

steps: Cut several finger-thick slices from the salmon fillet.
Lard these with pencil-thick and half-finger-long pieces of truffle and similarly cut flounder.
Place them in a deep bowl, cover with 1 bay leaf, thinly sliced onion, some fresh parsley.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper, spray with lemon juice, and let stand covered for several hours, turning occasionally.
Prepare the butter dough and form the pâté as described in the 'Goose Liver Pâté' recipe (No. 1057).

Once the dough of the prepared pâté is lined inside with thin slices of bacon, spread the bottom 2 fingers high with fish farce, lay the salmon slices upon it, spread again 2 fingers high with farce, and continue until the pâté is completely filled.
Proceed as described in the 'Goose Liver Pâté' recipe.
This pâté, which is served on fast days, can be enjoyed both warm and cold; in the latter case, however, only after 2 days.

title: Karpfen in saurer brauner Sauce (Carp in Sour Brown Sauce)
description: A sauce made with carp, butter or fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: very little finely chopped root vegetables
1/2 litre water (or as much liquid as needed for sauce)
5 grains of each type of spice
approximately 1 kilo carp, cut into 2-finger wide pieces

steps: In 16 decilitres of butter or fat, add 1 piece of finely chopped onion and very little finely chopped root vegetables
Allow this to roast covered for a short time
Add 12 decilitres flour and let it brown

Add 1/4 litre vinegar, 1/2 litre water (or as much liquid as needed for sauce), 3 sprigs thyme, 2 crushed juniper berries, 1 bay leaf, 5 grains of each type of spice, 5 sprigs parsley tied together, and 1 small piece of lemon peel
Let this simmer for 1/2 hour
Place approximately 1 kilo of carp, cut into 2-finger wide pieces, in a casserole
Pour the sauce over and let it simmer covered for another 1/2 hour
Arrange the fish elevated on a platter
Mix the carp blood with 1 tablespoon vinegar, then with 1 1/4 litres sour cream and 3 egg yolks, stirring well
Stir this mixture into the sauce
Pour part of this sauce over the fish and serve the rest in a sauceboat

description: Prepared with carp, fish, and vegetables.
steps: Clean, wash, and slice the root vegetables into leaves

Cook the vegetables with 1 onion, fish blood, 6 peppercorns and spice berries, 4 cloves, a piece of ginger, lemon peel, 1 piece of garlic, grated gingerbread, salt, vinegar, beer, 2 bay leaves, a pinch of thyme, and elderberry sauce with enough water to cover for about 1 hour
Cut the fish into two-finger-width pieces
Place the fish pieces in the broth and let them simmer gently for 9-10 minutes
Remove the fish and keep it warm
Strain the broth through a sieve
In a casserole, brown 1 spoonful of sugar in 2 decagrams hot fat or butter
Add a very small amount of flour, stir it, and let it cool
Pour the broth over it
Add the prunes, some raisins, 6 swelled sliced almonds, and several half nuts
Season with salt, acid, and sugar to taste
Let it cook for 15-20 minutes
Pour the sauce over the fish pieces and serve with Bohemian dumplings

title: Karpfen, mit Blut gedünstет (Carp Braised with Blood)
description: Prepared with carp, onion, and wine.
steps: Open the carp so you get the blood cleanly, scale it, and cut it into pieces like the previous recipe
You can also keep the bundle if the gallbladder has been removed from it
Sprinkle the carp with a little salt
Put a piece of butter and a little cut onion on the bottom of a pot, place the carp on top
Add a little wine vinegar, pepper, several cloves, lemon peel, and bay leaves
Braise the carp with these, turn the pieces once, and when it is almost braised through, add a little pea broth
Make a brown roux with a piece of fat, a piece of sugar, and a spoonful of flour, add it to the pot
Let it boil a little more with these additions
Before serving, add the carp blood, let it come to a boil once more, arrange the carp on a dish, and pour the sauce over it

title: Karpfen-Pâtete (Carp Pâté)
description: Prepared with carp, fish, and salt.
steps: Open, clean, and wash a scaled carp.
Sprinkle with salt and braise in the oven with occasional basting.
Meanwhile, line a fish mold brushed with butter and lined with flour with finger-thick rolled-out butter dough.
Spread 1 finger high with cold fish farce.
Place the roasted but cold carp upon it, spread with some farce again, and fill up.
Cover with a finger-thick butter dough plate fitted to the size of the fish mold, whose edge is pressed together with that of the side wall.
Score the dough plate several times with a knife and brush with beaten eggs.

title: Karpfen-Ragout (Carp Ragout)
description: Prepared with carp, butter or fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: 5 grains of each type of spice
1 kilo carp, cut into 2-finger wide and 1-finger long pieces

steps: In a casserole, place 16 decilitres butter or fat, then a piece of onion and some root vegetables, finely chopped, 1 bay leaf, 5 sprigs thyme, and 5 grains of each type of spice
Lay the chopped fish head on top and let it simmer covered for approximately 1/4 hour
Add 1 kilo carp cut into 2-finger wide and 1-finger long pieces and 1/3 litre white or red wine, some meat broth or water, and 8 decilitres black bread
Let this simmer covered and gently for 1/2 hour
Arrange the fish pieces going around on a platter, strain and degrease the sauce
Adjust the seasoning with vinegar or lemon and salt, and let the sauce come to a boil
Pour over the fish
In the centre, serve a ragout of crayfish, mushrooms, artichoke hearts, and similar items

title: Kartoffel-Rostbraten à l'Esterhazy (Beef Roast Esterhazy)
description: Prepared with beef, fat or marrow or beef, and onion.

ingredients.name: fat or marrow from beef roast
vinegar or wine and broth or water

steps: Place fat and minced beef bones in a casserole
Add 1 large onion and 1 small yellow turnip, both sliced leafy
Add salt and seasoning to taste
Place the flattened beef roast pieces on top
Braise covered until they have reduced
Add a piece of black bread and enough vinegar or wine and broth or water so the liquid rises just above the meat
Braise covered for 1 hour
Transfer the roast to another casserole
Remove fat from the sauce and strain it over the roast
Add 1/2 liter cream
Add 1 tablespoon chopped capers and anchovy fillets, as many pieces as there are roast pieces
Braise these gently until completely tender
1/2 liter cream is sufficient for 6 roast pieces

title: Kartoffelknödel (Potato Dumpling)
description: Prepared with potatoes, bread, and semolina.
steps: Cook potatoes in their skins the day before

Mix with bread cubes that have been roasted in hot fat and cut into cubes
Add salt, 1 tablespoon semolina, and flour stirred in by the spoonful
Add flour until dumplings show no cracks
Form dumplings
Place in a casserole in much boiling salt water
Cook slowly for 5-8 minutes

title: Kartoffelpudding (Potato Pudding)
description: A pudding made with egg yolks, bread, and potatoes.
steps: Cream together 7 dkg butter
Mix in 3 egg yolks and salt
Add 6 bread rolls (trimmed, soaked in milk, and well drained)
Mix in 18 dkg cooked, passed, and cooled potatoes
Fold in 3 stiffly beaten egg whites
Fill into a pudding mold and steam for ¾ hour
Loosen, turn out, pour melted butter over, and serve warm
